title: Maintainer overview
description: Develop and release tempjs CLI and website templates from the monorepo.

blocks.title: Monorepo layout
blocks.text: packages/core is a starter kit copied once when you run pnpm new-template. After that, edit templates/<name>/ directly — no sync required for normal work.

blocks.code:
pnpm new-template bakery bakery-website-template --name "Bakery"
edit templates/bakery-website-template/
pnpm dev:bakery
tempjs version inc patch bakery
